I gathered and analyzed business requirements through client interactions and stakeholder workshops, translating them into detailed documentation including BRDs, FRDs, and user stories with defined acceptance criteria. I collaborated closely with development teams to design and enhance RESTful APIs used in customer onboarding, loan management, and transaction processing. WORK EXPERIENCE
ITC Infotech – Senior Business Analyst
Aug 2022 – June 2 0 2 6
Acted as a liaison between business stakeholders and the technical team to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for telecom domain applications (Client: AT&T, Citi).
Led end-to-end requirement elicitation and translated them into well-defined user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria using tools like Jira, Confluence, and Lucidchart.
Participated in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and facilitated backlog grooming to ensure user stories aligned with business priorities.
Collaborated with UI/UX teams to create mockups and wireframes for new features and presented these to clients for validation.
Conducted UAT and BVT, prepared test cases, and coordinated with QA teams to ensure timely defect resolution and on-time delivery.
Worked closely with developers to ensure technical feasibility and scope alignment, while maintaining traceability of requirements throughout the SDLC.
Managed change requests and impact assessments by coordinating with product owners and business heads, ensuring seamless updates to ongoing development.
Played a key role in improving operational efficiency by identifying automation opportunities and proposing enhancements through data-driven analysis.
Espire – Business Analyst
Jan 2020 – Aug 2022
Worked with leading financial institutions (Clients: Citi Bank and Kuwait Finance House) to modernize digital banking platforms and streamline loan processing and customer service workflows.
Conducted detailed requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders, translated business needs into clear functional and non-functional requirements (BRD, FRD, SRS).
Designed and documented API specifications and integration points between frontend, middleware, and backend systems in collaboration with technical architects.
Supported Agile delivery teams by creating and refining user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritizing backlog items.
Participated in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and sprint reviews, ensuring alignment between technical output and business expectations.
Conducted UAT planning and coordination, prepared test scenarios and scripts, and validated final product deliverables in coordination with QA and business teams.
• Managed change requests and incident tracking through tools like Jira and Confluence. • Worked closely with cross-functional teams including product owners, development teams, QA, and operations
to ensure successful feature deployment and client satisfaction.

PROJECTS
AT&T(Mexico)
At AT&T, I served as a Senior Business Analyst where I was responsible for bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams in delivering enhancements to the telecom service management platform. My role involved gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements for key features such as keyword management, rebranding workflows, and database optimization. I converted these requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria using tools like Jira and Confluence, and collaborated closely with developers and QA teams in an Agile environment to ensure timely delivery. I also created mockups and process flow diagrams to provide visual clarity and validation during requirement walkthroughs. As part of the UAT phase, I coordinated end-to-end testing, prepared detailed test cases, and managed defect resolution. I was actively involved in handling change requests, performing impact analysis, and maintaining requirement traceability throughout the SDLC. Post-deployment, I supported hypercare activities and facilitated user training sessions to ensure smooth adoption of new functionalities. My contribution helped streamline internal workflows and enhance the overall user experience on the AT&T platform.
Kuwait Finance House
At Kuwait Finance House, I worked as a Business Analyst, where I was responsible for gathering and analyzing requirements for various digital banking modules, including account management, loan servicing, and financial reporting. I collaborated closely with product owners, subject matter experts, and technical teams to translate business needs into detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), ensuring alignment with compliance and regulatory standards. My role involved working on API enhancement and integration, where I documented request and response structures and supported backend coordination. I created process flows, use case diagrams, and data mapping documents to support the implementation of new features and enhancements. As part of an Agile team, I actively participated in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, while also managing UAT execution—preparing test cases, coordinating defect resolution, and ensuring successful business sign-off. Additionally, I played a key role in production support, performing impact analysis and addressing critical issues, while also contributing to the creation of user manuals and training materials to support end- user adoption.
Citi Bank
At Citi Bank, I worked as a Business Analyst where I was involved in the enhancement of the bank’s digital banking platform, focusing on improving user experience, streamlining loan processing, and ensuring compliance with evolving financial regulations. I gathered and analyzed business requirements through client interactions and stakeholder workshops, translating them into detailed documentation including BRDs, FRDs, and user stories with defined acceptance criteria. I collaborated closely with development teams to design and enhance RESTful APIs used in customer onboarding, loan management, and transaction processing. In an Agile environment, I actively participated in sprint ceremonies, managed product backlogs, and ensured clear communication between business and technical stakeholders. I also played a key role in UAT planning and coordination, creating test cases, facilitating defect triage, and obtaining business sign-off for production releases. Additionally, I supported deployment activities using Jenkins and monitored post-release issues during the hypercare phase. My work contributed to delivering secure, user-friendly banking features while aligning with the bank's strategic digital transformation goals.Worked as a Business Analyst on digital banking transformation initiatives, partnering with business stakeholders to define Current State (AS-IS) processes, identify pain points, and design Future State (TO-BE) operating models aligned with business and regulatory objectives. Collaborated with business and technology teams on Target Operating Model (TOM) initiatives, supporting operating model improvements, process standardization, and digital transformation across customer onboarding, loan management, and transaction processing. Conducted detailed requirement gathering workshops and translated business needs into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications. Performed Business Architecture and Process Architecture analysis by documenting business capabilities, business processes, system interactions, and end-to-end workflow dependencies to support solution design. Facilitated Customer Journey Mapping workshops to analyse customer touchpoints, identify service gaps, improve user experience, and streamline digital banking journeys. Created AS-IS/TO-BE process maps, performed Gap Analysis and impact assessments, and recommended process optimisation opportunities to improve operational efficiency and customer experience. Worked closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners, Developers, QA, Operations,
and Business stakeholders to ensure business requirements were accurately translated into technical solutions. Managed Agile ceremonies, prioritised product backlogs, refined user stories, coordinated UAT planning and execution, resolved defects, and obtained business sign-off for production releases. Supported deployment, hypercare, change management, and post-production issue resolution while ensuring compliance with banking standards and governance requirements.
